[vanyellow] very tempting
was thinking of getting a thor but this at over half the price
good to hear ps2 works fine
[adrianhughes1998] I see the TrimUI Smart Pro S but then I see this.
Shit, decisions, decisions…
[theguyrules] Title says 6GB, pricing in post is for 4GB
[Budget Gengar] Haven't owned a handheld before and looking for some guidance..
Will this device be enough if I just wanted to play Pokemon, from Gameboy (eg. Red,Blue,Yellow) and everything up to Ultra Sun & Moon (3DS)?
What if I wanted to play the Nintendo Switch Pokemon games? Would this still work or would a AYN Thor be more suitable?
[ekswhyzed] Yes, it'll play Pokemon up to 3DS. Some 3DS games may not be able to be upscaled and may have occasional hitches but 99% yeah it's good.
Switch games, I doubt. See if you can find any youtube videos showing it but I think this will be too underpowered. Yes the Ayn Thor would play them, but is that hundreds of $ price difference worth that? Maybe a used switch is a better buy for those?
[Fergy1987] Bought the RG DS plus and kind of wish I grabbed this because gamma seems like it's going to make some major improvements.
Oh well. Might just save up for a Thor or the duo later.
[SeanConnery] It really depends on what games you want to play and how nostalgic you want to be.
If I want to play DS games only, then the RG DS Plus is simply perfect. I'd load it up with DS games only, and nothing else.
[SeanConnery] PS2 at native 1x resolution can look pretty rough depending on the game. I don't recommend it all. 1.5x would be my absolute minimum. If you want to play PS2 only and not worry about DS or 3DS games, I'd recommend the Anbernic RG476H as the new drivers with ARMSX2 can play almost the entire library at 1.5x easily and 1x for the very heavy games.
If TCB bring back the 35% cashback + 10% team cashback and coupons, you could pick one up for about $130.
[McMaferMur] i have switch 1 modded, ps vita, n3dsxl, and r36s.
if i want to keep the switch, what is one device that can replace ps vita, n3dsxl, and r36s (to complement the switch not overlapping). not playing PC games at all. i like clamp style
[cerealsmok3r] Looks good. They even got the game body purple see through and GameCube controller colours.
I would’ve gotten if I didn’t have a modded switch haha. It was $180 inc. the clip to mod
[assarabbiya] I can totally relate with the kid life 👍
[clandestino] I don't get it, tbh..
Your spending $200+ to play pirated copies of 20+ year old games?
$100 I could understand.
[Clockwerk] Emulating DS/3DS games are shite without the dual screens. This and the Thor are the best ways to play them, you can also set them up to have achievements, mods, resolution bumps. They can also play steam games.
